summary: DigitalOcean Holdings filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity program of up to $1.0 billion of common stock under an equity distribution agreement dated November 2, 2026, with Goldman Sachs, J.P. Morgan, Morgan Stanley, BofA, MUFG, Citizens JMP, Wells Fargo and BMO as sales agents. Shares may be sold at prevailing market prices; last reported price was $89.79 on November 2, 2026. Agents receive up to 2.0% of gross proceeds. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution pace and any accelerated selling pressure on DOCN.
